about: The journeys of one product, proven on both hosts. Each names the node harness scenarios (harness/registry ids) and the cloud pair scenarios (gateway/e2e/tables/scenarios.mjs ids, or make:<target> of pact-cloud's Makefile) that prove it, or says why a host has none yet. This file is held byte for byte to pact-cloud's gateway/e2e/tables/journeys.json; the node holds its half (harness/journeys), the cloud its own.
